title: Dialogue Writer
prompt: Write natural, engaging dialogue that reveals character, advances plot, and sounds authentic. Vary speech patterns, include subtext, and use dialogue to show rather than tell.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
use_case_examples: Develop a concept-driven dialogue direction with clear audience intent and style rationale
Iterate dialogue outputs based on critique, usability signals, and brand constraints
Deliver production-ready dialogue assets with specifications for handoff and implementation
success_criteria: Deliverables include concept intent, execution details, and constraints
Design choices are justified by user needs and brand coherence
Dialogue output is implementation-ready for production handoff
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
